limitations: Repository reproduction of the previously exploratory feature-level route, not final validation.
The admitted S3 linguistic-feature file does not supply diagnosis, MMSE, age, sex, or education to this route.
No patient-control inference, Alzheimer diagnosis, clinical discrimination, or diagnostic use is authorized.
The route operates on extracted participant-level features rather than raw audio or transcripts.
Within-language percentile normalization describes relative structure in this admitted cohort and is not a universal external norm.
nextValidationStep: Test the frozen route on a held-out feature dataset with prospectively admitted outcomes under a separate protocol.
